title: Photo Edit
description: Upload a photo and pick one precise edit — enhance, remove an object, professional polish, change the background, isolate a person, black & white, cozy warm, sharpen details, or blur the background.

presets.label: Photo enhance
presets.prompt:
Dramatically improve this photo into a polished, professional-quality portrait while keeping the same person, same pose, same clothing, and same location. Re-light the subject with flattering soft directional key light and gentle fill so the face is bright, dimensional, and clearly separated from the background — eliminate flat, dull, or overhead lighting. Add depth of field: render the background with natural, creamy optical blur so the subject pops, and clean up background clutter and distracting bright spots. Apply a rich, film-like color grade with deep clean blacks, luminous highlights, and vivid but natural color.

Critical constraints: preserve the person's exact same face, eyes, skin and appearance.

presets.label: Remove Object
presets.prompt: Remove the specific unwanted object or person the user describes. Fill the area naturally so it looks like the object was never there. Preserve the exact appearance of the person that's the main subject of the photo. Do not change anything about them, just remove the object they want to remove.

presets.label: Professional Polish
presets.prompt: Transform this casual photo into a polished, professional-quality portrait of the exact same person, clothing, jewelry, and location. Re-light the subject with soft directional key light from a flattering angle plus gentle fill so their face is bright, dimensional, and clearly separated from the background, eliminating flat or overhead lighting. Add natural creamy optical depth of field that renders the background with smooth bokeh blur, cleaning up clutter and distracting bright spots so the subject pops forward. Apply a rich film-like color grade featuring deep clean blacks, luminous highlights, and vivid yet natural colors. The final image must look like the same person captured by a professional photographer with excellent lighting and a fast lens.

presets.label: Background Changer
presets.prompt: Replace the entire background with a new one that the user describes. Keep the main subject sharp and correctly lit for the new background. Make sure that the proportion of the main subject of the picture is logical compared to the background proportions so the main subject does not lok overly big or overly small compared to the new background.

presets.label: Isolate Person
presets.prompt: Isolate the person the user describes into a portrait of them in the same setting but by themselves. Remove everyone else just keep the original setting and the close up portrait of the person. If the person is wearing anything on their face, keep it exactly the same. Maintain their facial features precisely.

presets.label: Black & White
presets.prompt:
Convert this photograph into a beautiful black and white image with the quality of fine-art film photography. Aim for a balanced, correctly exposed result — neither dark and heavy nor bright and washed out. Build a full tonal range: rich blacks that hold visible shadow detail, bright highlights that retain full detail and never blow out to pure white, and well-distributed midtones with clear separation between tonal steps.

Render the skin just above middle gray — luminous and flattering, but with clear tonal modeling and visible gradation across the face. Skin should never approach pure white or lose highlight detail; retain detail in the brightest areas of the forehead, nose, and cheekbones. Light the face with soft diffused light that wraps gently, giving soft-edged shadows and no harsh dark blotches. Keep natural skin texture present but rendered softly — do not sharpen, crunch, or add micro-contrast to skin.

Carry the image's contrast in the hair, clothing, background, and surrounding scene rather than in the face. Separate the subject from the background through luminance difference. Sharpen and add detail to the eyes, eyelashes, brows, and hair, and give the eyes bright clear catchlights.

Render with fine organic film grain and smooth natural highlight roll-off, in the character of a classic portrait film stock like Ilford Delta 100 — clean, luminous, medium contrast. No color anywhere, no sepia or split-toning. Avoid a muddy or underexposed look, avoid crushed blacks, and equally avoid an overexposed, blown-out, or hazy washed-out rendering. Protect highlight detail above all.

presets.label: Cozy Warm
presets.prompt:
Grade this photograph with a warm, cozy, inviting atmosphere while keeping it full color and natural. Shift the lighting toward golden-hour warmth: render the light sources and highlights with a soft amber-golden glow, as if lit by late afternoon sun or warm lamplight. Keep the shadows neutral to very slightly cool so the image stays dimensional and never muddy or uniformly orange.

Add a gentle soft-light bloom around bright areas and light sources, with smooth luminous highlight roll-off. Lift the blacks slightly for a soft, film-like, enveloping feel rather than harsh contrast. Enrich warm tones in wood, fabric, hair, and warm surfaces, and let cool elements in the scene stay cool so the warmth reads as light rather than a color cast. Keep whites recognizably white — warm-tinted, not yellow.

Critical constraints: preserve the subject's natural skin tone and undertone. Skin should look warmly lit and healthy, never orange, ruddy, sunburned, or jaundiced. Do not lighten, whiten, smooth, or even out skin, and keep natural texture including pores, fine lines, and freckles. Do not reshape faces or alter proportions. This is a full-color image — absolutely no sepia, no monochrome, no vintage yellow filter, no uniform color overlay. The result should feel like a warmly lit moment captured on film: cozy, soft, and inviting, with natural color intact.

presets.label: Sharpen Details
presets.prompt: Increase sharpness, texture, and micro-contrast throughout the image for crisper, more defined details. Enhance edge definition and fine detail in the hair, clothing, eyes, and background while keeping the overall look natural and realistic. Do not change colors, tones, lighting, composition, or the subject's appearance beyond the added clarity and sharpness.

presets.label: Blur Background
presets.prompt: Keep the main subject sharp and add natural background blur/bokeh.

presets.label: Chibi
presets.prompt: Create a cute anime chibi character of the person from the image, rendered as a high-quality glossy 3D blender style figurine: smooth reflective toy-like plastic materials, strong specular highlights, soft reflections, shiny surfaces. Preserve the person's original race, ethnicity, skin tone, hair color, facial likeness, eye color, and clothing colors precisely. Use classic chibi proportions with a very large head, small torso, simplified cute features, and large over-sized expressive sparkling eyes. Frame from the torso up with the upper body and head filling most of the frame. The person looks directly at the camera with an energetic, pose fit for this type of environment and scene. Preserve the environment that the person is in as the background, making it slightly bokeh.

presets.label: Comic Book
presets.prompt: Transform the input image into an original comic-book / graphic-novel illustration style while preserving the subject's recognizable identity, pose, clothing, and everyday setting. Reinterpret the scene as a single panel from a slice-of-life indie comic: an ordinary, mundane 'day in the life' moment (e.g. sipping coffee, commuting, walking the dog, at a desk, cooking) — calm and relatable, NOT action or heroic. Use bold black ink outlines, clean confident linework, flat cel-shaded color blocks, and halftone / ben-day dot shading with subtle vintage newsprint texture. Keep the face recognizable but lightly stylized. Do NOT add superheroes, capes, costumes, masks, powers, logos, emblems, speech bubbles, sound effects, or any text. Absolutely no copyrighted, trademarked, or franchise characters or styles — a completely original, generic comic look applied to a real everyday scene.

presets.label: 3D Character
presets.prompt: Create a charming cartoon character of the person from the image. Frame from the torso up with the upper body and head filling most of the frame. Pose, cute and charismatic personality, polished high-quality 3D cartoon style, highly detailed, professional illustration. Maintain the original face, structure and hair details. Preserve the environment that the person is in as the background, making it slightly bokeh.

presets.label: 70's Street Style
presets.prompt: 1970s NYC candid street photograph of the person or people (if there are multiple people in the user-uploaded photo) in typical 70s outfit, close up picture. avoid too much text in the background.

presets.label: 80's Anime
presets.prompt: maintain original composition, facial expressions, and emotion of the original image. completely change the image style into: full illustrated ANIME STYLE: ultra high res video anime illustrated cartoon animated. retro 1980s aesthetic.,very moody lighting. in the style of a low res 1980s anime screengrab. VCR VHS. retro anime screencap. cartoon. CRT scanlines. bloom. halation. heavy film grain. Smooth perfect skin details.

presets.label: Sunday Morning
presets.prompt: Warm, nostalgic 35mm film still aesthetic with a soft 1970s/early-80s pastoral-cinema vibe. Golden-hour backlight flooding the frame: rich amber/orange highlights, warm skin tones, and honey-colored grasses. Gentle film halation (soft glowing bloom around bright areas and sunlit edges), slightly lifted blacks with a mild matte fade, and smooth highlight roll-off (no harsh clipping). Medium-wide composition with the subject placed left-of-frame and lots of negative space to the right; a calm, observational, “quiet moment” tone. Shallow-to-moderate depth of field: foreground grasses softly blur into the lens, subject readable but not razor sharp, background trees softened. Naturalistic contrast, slightly low micro-contrast, creamy texture. Subtle film grain throughout (fine, organic grain), mild softness and lens character (gentle vignetting, slight flare), and a restrained color palette that leans warm gold + muted greens. Overall look: dreamy, intimate, sun-drenched, painterly realism like a still from an art-house coming-of-age film.
